name: Driving Empire
creator: Driving Empire by Voldex
redeem: Launch Driving Empire on Roblox and spawn into the city.
Click the gear (Settings) icon in the menu on the left side of the screen.
Open the Codes section and click the Input code box.
Type or paste a code and press Submit to get your Cash or car.
notes:
Driving Empire is an open world driving and racing game from Voldex, the studio that also runs Brookhaven. You earn Cash by driving, racing, and doing jobs, then buy from more than 300 cars and boats, many from real brands like Lamborghini, McLaren, and Porsche. You can tune and customize every car, join races and car meets, and roleplay around a big map with friends.

Codes mostly give Cash, plus the odd free car or pack of tuning kits. Cash is the most useful reward because it goes straight toward the car you are saving for, while free cars are nice extras for your garage. New codes usually drop with the game's regular updates, like the Rivian update in late September 2026, and for milestones, and they are posted on X and in the Discord.

faq.q: Why is my Driving Empire code not working?
faq.a: Driving Empire codes expire quickly, often within a few weeks, so older codes like 10KITS and MARCH2026 no longer work. Also check that you typed it in all capitals with no spaces.

faq.q: Where do I find the codes box in Driving Empire?
faq.a: It is inside the Settings menu. Click the gear icon on the left of the screen and look for the Codes section with the Input code box.

faq.q: Can I get free cars from Driving Empire codes?
faq.a: Yes, some codes give a car instead of Cash. Right now USA250 gives the Rocket Car and 2MLIKES gives a 2017 Nissan GT-R.

tips: Pick one affordable car you like and tune it, instead of saving for a supercar from day one. A tuned car helps you earn Cash faster from races.
Test tuning changes by driving around the open world before a race. Small changes can make a car handle very differently.
Join limited events like NASCAR Las Vegas while they run. Event modes are a good change from normal races and often come with their own rewards.
Go to car meets and community events to see what other players drive. It is an easy way to find cars worth saving for.
useRewards: The four Cash codes add up to 285,000 Cash, and two more codes give free cars, the Rocket Car and a 2017 Nissan GT-R. Redeem the car codes first, since a free car can save you from buying one. Then put the Cash toward the car you are saving for or tuning parts. Codes here expire quickly, so redeem them soon.
